data.description:
## Goal
Update instruction files to use render-closure-narrative.sh and remove free-form LLM narrative paths.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md: in Step 6 Output Verdict, call render-closure-narrative.sh to produce the narrative field; do NOT instruct the LLM to summarize or describe findings in prose
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md: in Phase G epic-closure narrative output, call render-closure-narrative.sh instead of any LLM-generate-summary instruction

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -r 'summarize\|write a narrative\|describe the findings' plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md → 0 results
- grep -c 'render-closure-narrative' plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md → ≥1
- bash tests/scripts/test-render-closure-narrative.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (instruction file updates — behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5; depends S2/T2)
data.title: T3: GREEN — Wire render-closure-narrative.sh into completion-verifier + sprint
